definition.description: Helper mode 1, weekly sweep (wbs:0.13, CO-011, TAD 5.12.1, ADR-089): logs what the jobs will delete (snapshot first), records each deletion, removes the signed PDF, flags overdue. NO Dataverse delete: the jobs delete (ADR-004). See notes.md.

metadata.description: Environment variable. The process owner who gets the weekly summary (C-TECH-047).
Environment variable. The site holding the signed-acceptance library.

Every_Monday_at_00_30_UTC.description: TAD 5.12.1: weekly, Monday 00:30 UTC. Weekly, not monthly, because each environment's jobs run on whichever day of the month they were first provisioned. Frequency Week with weekDays (check 16: weekDays only with Week, IMP-1107).

Compose_retention_periods.description: TAD 5.12.1 step 1: the jobs' own periods in months, keyed by the jobKey of dataverse.bulkDeleteJobs (TAD 3.4.1). A unit test (src/tests/solutions/retention_helper) holds these equal to test-settings.json and prd-settings.json; change both together.

Compose_sweep_constants.description: Format constants of the weekly schedule, not tunables (TAD 5.12.1 trigger, ADR-089 gate interactions): 8 days so a clock passing before the next job run is seen by one weekly run first; 35 days so a job that has stopped shows within five weeks (NFR-010).

Compose_run_link.description: Deep link to THIS run, for the alerts.

Compose_overdue_cutoff.description: A Scheduled row older than this whose record still exists is Overdue.

Initialise_overdue_count.description: Records still there 35 days after their date.

Initialise_overdue_references.description: The overdue references, for the summary. References only.

variables.name: staleCaseLine
variables.value: Stale open cases are listed on the first run of each month.

List_paid_grants_due.description: paidGrantApplications rule, clock 8 days ahead: Grant Paid (11), grant final payment older than the period. A-RH-2: filters and expands through rev_applicationid. Secured both ways: rev_finalpaymentdate is REV_FinanceOnly.

parameters.$filter: @{concat('rev_finalpaymentdate lt ', addToTime(addDays(utcNow(), outputs('Compose_sweep_constants')?['lookAheadDays']), mul(-1, outputs('Compose_retention_periods')?['paidGrantApplications']), 'Month', 'yyyy-MM-dd'), ' and rev_applicationid/rev_status eq 11')}

Select_paid_applications_due.description: Rule Paid 6 years (1); the date the clock passes. Secured: its input carries the final payment dates.

List_rejected_applications_due.description: The rejectedApplications rule, clock moved 8 days ahead: Rejected (8) whose rev_decisiondate is older than the period. References and dates only.

parameters.$filter: @{concat('rev_status eq 8 and rev_decisiondate lt ', addToTime(addDays(utcNow(), outputs('Compose_sweep_constants')?['lookAheadDays']), mul(-1, outputs('Compose_retention_periods')?['rejectedApplications']), 'Month', 'yyyy-MM-dd'))}

List_withdrawn_incomplete_applications_d.description: The withdrawnIncompleteApplications rule, clock moved 8 days ahead: Withdrawn (9) or Incomplete (10) whose applicant's rev_lastcontactdate is older than the period. A-RH-2: the rev_applicantid navigation property, as Round Statistics expands it.

parameters.$filter: @{concat('(rev_status eq 9 or rev_status eq 10) and rev_applicantid/rev_lastcontactdate lt ', addToTime(addDays(utcNow(), outputs('Compose_sweep_constants')?['lookAheadDays']), mul(-1, outputs('Compose_retention_periods')?['withdrawnIncompleteApplications']), 'Month', 'yyyy-MM-dd'))}

Compose_applications_due.description: Every application whose clock passes on or before the next job run: ids, references, rule and date. No personal data.

Alert_pre_pass_failed.description: FR-010: no record reference; a run label.

body.text_2: The weekly retention sweep could not list the applications coming due. Nothing was logged this week for them; next week's run picks them up.

Find_an_existing_application_row.description: TAD 5.12.1 step 1: an application already logged Scheduled (or Overdue) is skipped, so a weekly re-run writes nothing twice.

parameters.$filter: @{concat('rev_runtype eq 1 and rev_datatype eq 2 and (rev_outcome eq 1 or rev_outcome eq 4) and rev_recordreference eq ''', items('For_each_application_due')?['reference'], '''')}

Call_the_snapshot_child.description: TAD 5.12.1 step 2: the Not Granted snapshot FR-055 needs, written only where TAD 5.13 step 3 says so; otherwise nothing.

Find_the_grant_pdf.description: The signed PDF's path, if the application has a grant with one (named with the grant reference).

Log_the_application_as_scheduled.description: TAD 5.12.1 step 3: Retention sweep (1), the application reference, Application (2), the rule, Scheduled (1), the date the clock passes, the signed PDF path if any. No personal data.

Find_applications_not_due.description: Those that are not themselves due.

Check_the_applicant_is_orphaned.description: TAD 5.12.1 step 3: a second row for the applicant only if no other application remains that is not itself due.

Find_an_existing_applicant_row.description: Idempotent on the log: an applicant already Scheduled or Overdue is not logged twice.

parameters.$filter: @{concat('rev_runtype eq 1 and rev_datatype eq 1 and (rev_outcome eq 1 or rev_outcome eq 4) and rev_recordreference eq ''', first(body('Get_the_orphaned_applicant')?['value'])?['rev_name'], '''')}

Log_the_applicant_as_scheduled.description: TAD 5.12.1 step 3: the applicant (with its bank accounts) goes with the orphanedApplicants job after its last application; its date is the latest of its due applications' dates.

body.text_2: The weekly retention sweep could not snapshot or log every application coming due. Next week's run picks up the rest (every step is idempotent on the log).

Reconcile_scheduled_rows.description: TAD 5.12.1 step 4: records the jobs' deletions and notices a job that has stopped.

List_scheduled_rows.description: TAD 5.12.1 step 4: every sweep row still Scheduled (or Overdue) whose date has passed.

parameters.$filter: @{concat('rev_runtype eq 1 and (rev_outcome eq 1 or rev_outcome eq 4) and rev_scheduledon lt ', outputs('Compose_today'))}

Check_the_row_is_for_an_application.description: Application rows and applicant rows are looked up in their own tables.

Look_up_the_logged_application.description: Is the application still there? By reference: the log holds text, not a lookup.

Check_the_application_is_gone.description: Gone: delete its PDF and mark Deleted. Still there: Overdue after 35 days.

Check_the_row_has_a_pdf.description: Only a row with a logged path.

Find_the_logged_pdf.description: A-ERA-3: the file's id from the logged path.

Delete_the_logged_pdf.description: FR-049: the signed PDF of a case the job has deleted. SharePoint Delete file; the only delete in mode 1.

Check_the_logged_pdf_was_already_gone.description: A-ERA-3: a 404 means the file is already gone; anything else fails the row.

Fail_on_the_logged_pdf_lookup.description: A deliberately failing step: Terminate is not allowed inside a loop (IMP-1098).
Fail_on_the_logged_pdf_lookup.inputs: @int('The signed PDF lookup failed, and not because it was already gone (A-ERA-3).')

Mark_the_application_row_deleted.description: Deleted (2); the path is cleared once the file is gone (TAD 5.12.3).

Check_the_application_is_overdue.description: Still there 35 days after its date.

Check_the_application_row_is_newly_overd.description: Set once; an already Overdue row keeps the date it became overdue.

Mark_the_application_row_overdue.description: Overdue (4): the job has not deleted it 35 days after its date (NFR-010).

Count_the_application_overdue.description: For the summary, every week until it is gone.

Look_up_the_logged_applicant.description: Is the applicant still there? By reference.

Check_the_applicant_is_gone.description: Gone, still there because of a new application, or overdue.

Mark_the_applicant_row_deleted.description: Deleted (2): the orphanedApplicants job removed it.

Find_an_open_application.description: A new application arrived if the applicant now has an open one (statuses 1 to 7).

Mark_the_applicant_row_not_due.description: TAD 5.12.1 step 4: Not due (3), not Overdue: the applicant stays because a new application arrived.

Check_the_applicant_is_overdue.description: Still there 35 days after its date with no new application.

Count_the_applicant_overdue.description: For the summary, every week until it is gone.

body.text_2: The weekly retention sweep could not reconcile every Scheduled row. Next week's run picks up the rest.

List_stale_open_cases_monthly.description: TAD 5.12.1 step 5: the first Monday of a month falls on day 1 to 7.

Get_the_stale_case_setting.description: The RetentionStaleCaseMonths rev_setting (default 12, decision D4). Never a literal here (FR-017).

Compose_stale_case_months.description: Fails when the row is missing or not a whole number; the step below then says so (ADR-089 consequence 2: a stated blackout, not fail-safe).

List_stale_open_cases.description: Applications in statuses 1 to 7 whose applicant has had no contact for the set number of months (A-R110). References only. Mode 1 never changes a status.

parameters.$filter: @{concat('rev_status le 7 and rev_applicantid/rev_lastcontactdate lt ', addToTime(utcNow(), mul(-1, outputs('Compose_stale_case_months')), 'Month', 'yyyy-MM-dd'))}

Set_the_stale_case_line.description: Decision D4: listed for the process owner to close.

inputs.name: staleCaseLine
inputs.value: @{if(empty(body('Select_stale_case_references')), concat('Stale open cases (no contact for ', string(outputs('Compose_stale_case_months')), ' months): none.'), concat('Stale open cases (no contact for ', string(outputs('Compose_stale_case_months')), ' months), close each as Withdrawn or Rejected: ', join(body('Select_stale_case_references'), ', ')))}

inputs.name: staleCaseLine
inputs.value: Stale open cases: not listed, because the RetentionStaleCaseMonths setting is missing or is not a whole number.

body.text_2: The monthly list of stale open cases could not be built.

Post_the_retention_summary.description: TAD 5.12.1 step 6: counts, and the references of overdue and stale cases. No names.

parameters.body/messageBody:
@{concat('

Weekly retention sweep

  • Coming due and logged: ', string(variables('scheduledCount')), '
  • Deleted by the retention jobs and recorded (signed PDFs removed): ', string(variables('deletedCount')), '
  • Overdue (still there 35 days after their date): ', string(variables('overdueCount')), if(empty(variables('overdueReferences')), '', concat(' - ', trim(variables('overdueReferences')))), '

', variables('staleCaseLine'), '

', if(or(equals(actions('Find_applications_due')?['status'], 'Failed'), equals(actions('Log_the_applications_due')?['status'], 'Failed'), equals(actions('Reconcile_scheduled_rows')?['status'], 'Failed')), '

Part of this run failed; see the failure alert. Next week''s run picks it up.

', ''), '

Counts and references only. The Retention Log in REV Grant Administration has the detail.

')}

body.text_2: The weekly retention summary could not be posted to Teams. The Retention Log holds the detail.
